children: DigitalBridge Group, Inc. Class A (NYSE:DBRG) is expanding its European tower footprint by joining a consortium to buy VodafoneZiggo’s passive mobile towers for a Belgium–Netherlands platform anchored by VodafoneZiggo and Telenet, while growing in Japan via Nippon Gateway Infrastructure (with JEXI) and assets including JTOWER and Vantage led by Soichiro Suda.
DigitalBridge Group, Inc. Class A Belgium-Netherlands Tower Platform
: DigitalBridge (DBRG) is part of a consortium acquiring VodafoneZiggo’s passive mobile tower assets to create an independent Belgium-Netherlands tower platform anchored by VodafoneZiggo and Telenet.
DigitalBridge Group, Inc. Class A Nippon Gateway Infrastructure Formed
: DigitalBridge (DBRG) formed Nippon Gateway Infrastructure in June 2026 with JEXI, acquiring NEC data centers. DBRG’s Japan assets include JTOWER and Vantage; Soichiro Suda leads Japan investments.
